create_classification_task: create a ClassificationTask with optional weights_key and exclude_background_class for single-label classification loss computation
create_multihead_classification_task: create a MultiHeadClassificationTask to compute loss across multiple task heads with per-head logits selection
create_multitask_classification_task: create a MultitaskClassificationTask to aggregate losses and accuracies across multiple named classification tasks
run_get_loss_and_aux: run get_loss_and_aux on ClassificationTask to compute weighted loss and accuracy from model logits and one-hot labels
run_get_infer_postprocessing_fn: run get_infer_postprocessing_fn on MultiHeadClassificationTask to get inference postprocessing that returns predictions and scaled probabilities
